803:t_1:3.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Briefing Room ～

803:t_1:4.en:
$$葵$$
「...The Captain and the others must be right in the middle of their strategy meeting by now...」

803:t_1:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「We're finally going down to $$蒼の地球$$ for the showdown with the $$新地球皇国$$, huh. I can't wait to fight!」

803:t_1:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You really can't think of anything but charging in, can you? Aren't you even more of a raging bull than $$エルーナルーナ$$?」

803:t_1:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't lump me in with that woman!」

803:t_1:8.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Sorry. You're not a bull, $$カレン$$. You were a bunny, weren't you?」

803:t_1:10.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Now, now... $$カレン$$. Easy, easy, easy...」

803:t_1:11.en:
$$カレン$$
「Now I'm being treated like a horse!」

803:t_1:12.en:
$$スザク$$
「If we go after $$ラース・バビロン$$ as things stand, it could turn out the same as last time.」

803:t_1:13.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then what are we supposed to do?」

803:t_1:14.en:
$$スザク$$
「Right now, most of $$蒼の地球$$ is under the control of the $$新地球皇国$$...」

803:t_1:15.en:
$$朔哉$$
「In that case, not that I'm $$カレン$$, but shouldn't we go for a single-point breakthrough?」

803:t_1:16.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「In the recent battle, $$エルーナルーナ$$ acknowledged our strength. Naturally, she will have prepared countermeasures.」

803:t_1:17.en:
$$くらら$$
「In other words, if we launch an assault, we'll end up getting counterattacked and wiped out, right?」

803:t_1:18.en:
$$葵$$
「So what are we supposed to do in this situation?」

803:t_1:19.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「A front stretched across the whole Earth is, so to speak, like a balloon filled to the brim with air.」

803:t_1:20.en:
$$スザク$$
「On a front deployed thin and wide, patching up one flaw only causes another flaw to appear...」

803:t_1:21.en:
$$スザク$$
「That spreads to every region in a chain reaction, and it could bring down the whole controlled area at once.」

803:t_1:22.en:
$$葵$$
「I see... So we're the ones who give it that first shock.」

803:t_1:23.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「Exactly. ...The $$地球連邦軍$$ has also timed its moves with ours and stuck to defense this past month.」

803:t_1:24.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「You're planning a massive counteroffensive, aren't you?」

803:t_1:26.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So to make that succeed, we're the ones who create flaws in the Empire's front line.」

803:t_1:27.en:
$$カレン$$
「Once we know that, all that's left is to do it.」

803:t_1:28.en:
$$スザク$$
「Calm down, $$カレン$$. To make this strategy succeed, we need to know exactly what the Empire is doing.」

803:t_1:29.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「But can we actually get that information?」

803:t_1:30.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「...No need to worry. I hear a perfect assist came in just a moment ago.」

803:t_1:32.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「The third $$クロノ$$... $$クィーン$$ has contacted us.」

803:t_1:37.en:
$$クィーン$$
「...That is everything I know about the Empire's movements on $$蒼の地球$$.」

803:t_1:38.en:
$$ブライト$$
「To think you'd have not only the fronts in each region, but even information on their collaborators, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and $$アマルガム$$.」

803:t_1:39.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「A third $$クロノ$$, neither Conservative nor Reformist... Where does your information come from?」

803:t_1:40.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Do you need to ask that?」

803:t_1:41.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You probably know this already, but it seems we have fallen out of favor with the Reformist $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

803:t_1:42.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That figures. He is earnest, but he has a capricious side.」

803:t_1:43.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「The Conservatives, now subordinate to the Empire, concern me too, but the change of heart of the Reformists, our former partners, calls for special caution.」

803:t_1:44.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Their strength is unknown, but with $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ among them, we need to stay alert.」

803:t_1:45.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Thinking about it is pointless.」

803:t_1:47.en:
$$クィーン$$
「It's like worrying about tomorrow's weather. Whether it's sunny or it rains, you have no choice but to accept it.」

803:t_1:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Are you telling us to accept $$アドヴェント#pilot$$?」

803:t_1:49.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That is for you to decide... All I can give you is information.」

803:t_1:50.en:
$$シャア$$
「Can we believe that you are on our side?」

803:t_1:51.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That is hardly what I'd expect from someone who hid his heart even from his sworn friend.」

803:t_1:52.en:
$$シャア$$
「People who talk in such a deliberately villainous way often turn out to be surprisingly trustworthy.」

803:t_1:54.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Hiding your form behind an avatar, hiding your true feelings as well, and yet cooperating with us... You may be a surprisingly cute woman.」

803:t_1:55.en:
$$クィーン$$
「That is a clumsy provocation, coming from you, $$ゼロ$$. A woman won't reveal her true feelings over something like that.」

803:t_1:56.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We can't spare the time to probe each other's intentions. We will make good use of the information you gave us.」

803:t_1:58.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「True, you give us useful information, but that is all it is: information. You have never used any concrete force.」

803:t_1:59.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「That means you are leaving the decision on how to proceed to us, and that you yourself remain neutral for now, I take it.」

803:t_1:60.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Let's say that's the case.」

803:t_1:61.en:
$$クィーン$$
「Well then, I will look forward to your good fight.」

803:t_1:62.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「If we overthrow the Empire, will you reveal your identity to us?」

803:t_1:64.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「As always, she won't let us catch her tail...」

803:t_1:65.en:
$$オットー$$
「What could she possibly be moving us for...」

803:t_1:66.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The one thing that's certain is that, since she calls herself the third $$クロノ$$, she will walk a path different from both the Empire and $$アドヴェント#pilot$$.」

803:t_1:67.en:
$$シャア$$
「So as long as that path overlaps with ours, she will cooperate as she did today.」

803:t_1:68.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Even if she is tossing the decision on how to proceed over to us, it is a fact that her help is useful.」

803:t_1:69.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Her information has settled the direction of the next phase of $$オペレーション・エクリプス$$ as well.」

803:t_1:70.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Defending Japan, the Empire's final strategic objective, containing $$ネオ・ジオン$$ in space, and pursuing $$アマルガム$$, correct?」

803:t_1:71.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Exactly. We will split our forces into three to deal with the situation.」

803:t_1:72.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The Japan Defense Force will have the $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ and the $$真ゲッタードラゴン$$ as its motherships...」

803:t_1:73.en:
$$ブライト$$
「$$ザンボット３$$, $$ダイターン３$$, the $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$, $$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$, the $$クラッシャー隊$$, the $$マジンガーチーム$$, the $$ゲッター$$ Team, $$大グレン団$$, $$チームＤ$$...」

803:t_1:74.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The $$バスターマシン$$, $$２１世紀警備保障$$, $$ビッグオー$$, the EVA series, the two $$アクエリオン$$, and the $$ガンレオン$$ will go.」

803:t_1:76.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The $$ネオ・ジオン$$ containment force will have the $$ラー・カイラム$$, the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ and the $$プトレマイオス２改$$ as its motherships...」

803:t_1:77.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It will be made up of the mobile suit units and the $$バルゴラ・グローリーＳ$$, which operates in a similar way.」

803:t_1:78.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「You could call it the all-Gundam team.」

803:t_1:79.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The $$アマルガム$$ pursuit force will have the $$マクロス・クォーター$$ and the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ as its motherships...」

803:t_1:80.en:
$$ブライト$$
「The $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ and Captain $$ガムリン$$, AS, KMF, $$ＡＴ$$, $$桂$$, $$レド$$, $$ラケージ$$... and the $$リ・ブラスタ$$.」

803:t_1:81.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(A force like this can maneuver nimbly... I could use this chance to confirm my own suspicion...)

803:t_1:82.en:
$$オットー$$
「$F doesn't seem to have been assigned to any unit, though.」

803:t_1:83.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「He is something of a joker for us.」

803:t_1:84.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The Empire's Reactors treat $n a little differently from the other three.」

803:t_1:85.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Are they urging him toward completion, since he is still an immature Reactor?」
